recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the publisher or stylesheet later regresses the class="codes" output or border styling for value-set mapping tables.
issue_request: FHIR-3469 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet correction asking for a border around the address-use Code Mappings table for v2/v3 mappings, with the same visual fix applying to Administrative Gender.
initial_application: Jira says the issue was applied on 2014-09-29 in SVN revision 2926. Git commit 01450fc93c960330155152e63812dc6f702cc001 is the imported SVN 2926 commit, titled "Fix codes table to have borders", and changed generated value-set tables to emit class="codes".
additional_context: The old Java NarrativeGenerator files changed by SVN 2926 are no longer in this checkout, but current source and the CI build preserve the same rendered contract. The local stylesheet gives table.codes a black outer border and bordered cells, and build.fhir.org renders both AddressUse and AdministrativeGender mapping columns inside table class="codes".
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current source correction is needed.
